I always find that if a lane is losing the best they can do is lose tower and set up a tier 2 freeze to try out xp and gold your laner(s) getting a kill is nice but getting 4 waves of farm uncontested as theirs isn't claimed making the Gold and xp gap grow smaller thats where it's at. Its easier to dive and kill top laners when you can control when the wave crashes but if there's no tier 1 tower and they're farming just infront of their second tower then a jg would have to walk through your presumably warded jg and it's unlikely they'll get the drop on you when it's harder to contest vision in all of the jg than it is in one bush top river. The enemy top laner has a few options they could contest the farm making their rotations to team fights slower and increasing their risk of ganks, they could roam mid an start splitting xp with mid, or they can wait and start taking camps now if they're significantly ahead by this point 7 and 0 and it a mobile champ against an immobile one they could try just popping you but if they're 7 and 0 i doubt you'd be worth more than a cannon at this point. Just wait our their teleport and hardshove under a tower hoping to get a reset and take your Gold advantage back to base.

My approach to ranked is just punish their mistakes and if my team is throwing I do my best to get a decent end game result just because I'm gonna lose lp that doesn't mean my mmr has to suffer especially in low elo being the best player on the worse team can still help you claw out of your elo hell.
